title: Halal Dining
english: Karim is visiting a big city for work, with hundreds of restaurants on every street. He wants to find food that is both halal and healthy, but it is not always easy to know which places are trustworthy.

He finally finds a small restaurant with grilled chicken and fresh vegetables near his hotel. "Excuse me, is this food halal?" he asks the waiter carefully. "Yes, of course, everything here is halal certified," the waiter answers with a smile.

Karim orders his meal and enjoys every bite after a long, tiring day of meetings. It is tasty, simple, and prepared with clean ingredients, which matters a great deal to him after weeks of unfamiliar travel food.

Before leaving the city, Karim saves the restaurant's location on his phone for future trips. Finding a reliable halal option, he realizes, is a small detail that makes traveling for work considerably less stressful.
indonesian: Karim sedang mengunjungi kota besar untuk urusan kerja, dengan ratusan restoran di setiap jalan. Ia ingin menemukan makanan yang halal sekaligus sehat, tapi tidak selalu mudah untuk tahu tempat mana yang bisa dipercaya.

Ia akhirnya menemukan restoran kecil dengan ayam panggang dan sayuran segar dekat hotelnya. "Permisi, apakah makanan ini halal?" tanyanya hati-hati kepada pelayan. "Ya, tentu saja, semuanya di sini bersertifikat halal," jawab pelayan sambil tersenyum.

Karim memesan makanannya dan menikmati setiap suapan setelah hari yang panjang dan melelahkan penuh rapat. Rasanya enak, sederhana, dan disiapkan dengan bahan yang bersih, hal yang sangat berarti baginya setelah berminggu-minggu makan makanan asing saat bepergian.

Sebelum meninggalkan kota itu, Karim menyimpan lokasi restoran itu di ponselnya untuk perjalanan berikutnya. Menemukan pilihan halal yang bisa diandalkan, ia sadari, adalah detail kecil yang membuat perjalanan kerja jauh lebih tidak menegangkan.

title: Sunnah Sports
english: Bilal spends most of his week sitting at a desk, and he wants to stay active outside of work. He remembers reading that swimming and archery are both mentioned as Sunnah, so he decides to try archery first.

Every Sunday morning, he goes to the archery field with two colleagues from his office. They practice together patiently, take turns shooting arrows, and always encourage each other after every single attempt.

Bilal feels stronger, calmer, and genuinely more focused after each practice session ends. Having a healthy, active body outside of his desk job, he realizes, helps him concentrate better during the rest of his working week.
After several months, Bilal notices that his weekend archery sessions have become the part of his routine he looks forward to most, a habit that keeps both his body and his mind in far better shape.
indonesian: Bilal menghabiskan sebagian besar minggunya duduk di meja kerja, dan ia ingin tetap aktif di luar pekerjaan. Ia ingat pernah membaca bahwa berenang dan memanah sama-sama disebut sebagai Sunnah, jadi ia memutuskan untuk mencoba memanah terlebih dahulu.
Setiap Minggu pagi, ia pergi ke lapangan panahan bersama dua rekan kerjanya. Mereka berlatih bersama dengan sabar, bergantian memanah, dan selalu saling menyemangati setelah setiap kali mencoba.

Bilal merasa lebih kuat, lebih tenang, dan benar-benar lebih fokus setelah setiap sesi latihan berakhir. Memiliki tubuh yang sehat dan aktif di luar pekerjaan mejanya, ia sadari, membantunya lebih berkonsentrasi selama sisa minggu kerjanya.

Setelah beberapa bulan, Bilal menyadari bahwa sesi memanah akhir pekannya telah menjadi bagian rutinitas yang paling ia nantikan, kebiasaan yang menjaga tubuh dan pikirannya dalam kondisi jauh lebih baik.

title: At the Doctor
english: Rafi has had a bad headache and a mild fever since yesterday afternoon. After trying to push through his workday, he finally decides to leave the office early and visit a small clinic near his apartment.
"What seems to be wrong today?" the nurse asks kindly as Rafi sits down across from her. "My head hurts a lot, and I have felt hot and tired since last night," Rafi explains, rubbing his temples.

The nurse gently checks his temperature and asks a few more questions about his symptoms and his week. "You simply need rest, water, and this medicine twice a day," she says, writing a short note for him.

Rafi thanks her and heads home, deciding to finally rest properly instead of ignoring his body's signals like he usually does. Sometimes, he thinks, taking a sick day is the most responsible choice a person can make.
indonesian: Rafi mengalami sakit kepala parah dan demam ringan sejak kemarin sore. Setelah mencoba bertahan menjalani hari kerjanya, ia akhirnya memutuskan untuk pulang lebih awal dan mengunjungi klinik kecil dekat apartemennya.

"Ada keluhan apa hari ini?" tanya perawat dengan ramah saat Rafi duduk di hadapannya. "Kepala saya sakit sekali, dan saya merasa panas serta lelah sejak semalam," jelas Rafi sambil memijat pelipisnya.

Perawat dengan lembut memeriksa suhu tubuhnya dan menanyakan beberapa pertanyaan lagi tentang gejalanya dan minggunya. "Kamu hanya perlu istirahat, minum air, dan obat ini dua kali sehari," katanya sambil menuliskan catatan singkat untuknya.

Rafi berterima kasih dan pulang, memutuskan untuk akhirnya benar-benar beristirahat alih-alih mengabaikan sinyal tubuhnya seperti biasanya. Kadang, pikirnya, mengambil cuti sakit adalah pilihan paling bertanggung jawab yang bisa diambil seseorang.

title: Drinking Enough Water
english: Nadia often forgets to drink water while she is busy with back-to-back meetings during the day. By the afternoon, her whole body starts to feel tired, her head hurts a little, and she cannot focus properly on her work.

One evening, her older sister gives her a small water bottle as a gift. "Try to drink a little every single hour, even during meetings," she suggests kindly. Nadia decides to give this new habit a real try.

After only a few days of doing this, Nadia already feels more awake, more focused, and full of energy throughout her workday. She even notices her afternoon headaches have almost completely disappeared since she started.

Nadia mentions this small change to her colleagues, and a few of them start doing the same. Drinking enough water throughout the day, she learns, is truly a small habit with a surprisingly large result.
indonesian: Nadia sering lupa minum air saat sedang sibuk dengan rapat yang berturut-turut di siang hari. Menjelang sore, seluruh tubuhnya mulai terasa lelah, kepalanya sedikit pusing, dan ia tidak bisa fokus dengan baik pada pekerjaannya.

Suatu malam, kakak perempuannya memberinya botol air kecil sebagai hadiah. "Cobalah minum sedikit setiap jam, bahkan saat rapat," sarannya dengan baik. Nadia memutuskan untuk benar-benar mencoba kebiasaan baru ini.

Setelah hanya beberapa hari melakukannya, Nadia sudah merasa lebih segar, lebih fokus, dan penuh energi sepanjang hari kerjanya. Ia bahkan menyadari sakit kepalanya di sore hari hampir sepenuhnya hilang sejak ia mulai kebiasaan ini.

Nadia menceritakan perubahan kecil ini kepada rekan-rekan kerjanya, dan beberapa dari mereka mulai melakukan hal yang sama. Minum air yang cukup sepanjang hari, ia pelajari, ternyata benar-benar kebiasaan kecil dengan hasil yang mengejutkan besar.

title: A Good Night's Sleep
english: Farid usually stays awake very late at night, scrolling through his phone after a long day of work. In the morning, he always feels extremely tired and finds it hard to focus properly during his first meeting.
One night, he finally decides to sleep earlier, right after finishing Isha prayer. He puts his phone in another room and takes a few slow, deep breaths to calm his mind before closing his eyes.

The next morning, Farid wakes up for Fajr prayer feeling truly fresh and clear-headed, something he had almost forgotten was possible on a weekday. His first meeting goes smoothly, and his ideas feel sharper than usual.
After a full week of this new routine, Farid tells his wife that a good night's sleep has quietly changed the quality of his entire workday, far more than any cup of coffee ever could.
indonesian: Farid biasanya begadang sampai larut malam, menggulir ponselnya setelah hari kerja yang panjang. Di pagi hari, ia selalu merasa sangat lelah dan sulit fokus dengan baik saat rapat pertamanya.

Suatu malam, ia akhirnya memutuskan untuk tidur lebih awal, tepat setelah menyelesaikan shalat Isya. Ia menyimpan ponselnya di ruangan lain dan menarik napas dalam-dalam perlahan untuk menenangkan pikirannya sebelum memejamkan mata.

Keesokan paginya, Farid bangun untuk shalat Subuh dengan perasaan benar-benar segar dan pikiran yang jernih, sesuatu yang hampir ia lupa masih mungkin terjadi di hari kerja. Rapat pertamanya berjalan lancar, dan ide-idenya terasa lebih tajam dari biasanya.

Setelah satu minggu penuh dengan rutinitas baru ini, Farid mengatakan kepada istrinya bahwa tidur yang cukup diam-diam mengubah kualitas seluruh hari kerjanya, jauh lebih baik daripada secangkir kopi mana pun.

title: Washing Hands Before Meals
english: Before every meal, Aisha makes a habit of washing her hands carefully, even during a busy workday. "Cleanliness is part of faith," her mother used to say, and the words still come back to her every single time.

At the office cafeteria, she notices that many of her colleagues skip this simple step, rushing straight from their desks to the food line. Aisha always takes the extra minute at the sink before joining them.

One week, half the office catches a cold that spreads quickly during lunch breaks. Aisha, however, stays healthy throughout, and a colleague jokingly asks her for the secret to avoiding the office cold.

Aisha simply smiles and explains her small, consistent habit. She has come to understand that one simple action, repeated without fail every day, can genuinely protect her health far better than she once assumed.
indonesian: Sebelum setiap kali makan, Aisha membiasakan diri mencuci tangan dengan teliti, bahkan di hari kerja yang sibuk. "Kebersihan adalah bagian dari iman," begitu kata ibunya dulu, dan kata-kata itu masih terngiang setiap kali.

Di kantin kantor, ia menyadari bahwa banyak rekan kerjanya melewatkan langkah sederhana ini, langsung bergegas dari meja kerja menuju barisan makanan. Aisha selalu meluangkan waktu ekstra di wastafel sebelum bergabung dengan mereka.

Suatu minggu, separuh kantor terkena flu yang menyebar cepat saat jam makan siang. Aisha, meski begitu, tetap sehat sepanjang waktu itu, dan seorang rekan bertanya bercanda apa rahasianya terhindar dari flu kantor.

Aisha hanya tersenyum dan menjelaskan kebiasaan kecilnya yang konsisten. Ia telah memahami bahwa satu tindakan sederhana, yang diulang tanpa gagal setiap hari, benar-benar bisa menjaga kesehatannya jauh lebih baik dari yang pernah ia duga.

title: Taking Regular Breaks at Work
english: Zain works at a desk for many hours. By the middle of the day, his head and neck often hurt. He thinks this is normal because his job is busy.
At a company health talk, he hears one simple idea. He can stand up and stretch for five minutes every hour. At first, Zain thinks he is too busy for this.
He tries short breaks for one week. In the afternoon, he feels more awake and notices fewer headaches. The change is small, but it helps him.
Now Zain sets a quiet alarm on his phone each hour. He walks to the window, fills his water bottle, or stretches his back and shoulders.
Zain tells his coworkers about the habit. It takes very little time, but it helps him feel better during his workday.
indonesian: Zain bekerja di meja selama berjam-jam. Menjelang tengah hari, kepala dan lehernya sering sakit. Ia mengira hal itu normal karena pekerjaannya sibuk.
Dalam ceramah kesehatan perusahaan, ia mendengar satu ide sederhana. Ia dapat berdiri dan meregangkan tubuh selama lima menit setiap jam. Awalnya, Zain merasa terlalu sibuk untuk melakukannya.
Ia mencoba jeda singkat selama satu minggu. Pada sore hari, ia merasa lebih segar dan lebih jarang sakit kepala. Perubahannya kecil, tetapi membantunya.
Sekarang Zain memasang alarm pelan di ponselnya setiap jam. Ia berjalan ke jendela, mengisi botol air, atau meregangkan punggung dan bahunya.
Zain menceritakan kebiasaan itu kepada rekan kerjanya. Kebiasaan ini memakai sedikit waktu, tetapi membantunya merasa lebih baik saat bekerja.
